newsitem.title: FRANCE: French family buys Bible video, gets porn movie.
newsitem.headline: French family buys Bible video, gets porn movie.

text.p: A French family which had apparently bought a video cassette of the Bible found itself watching a Spanish X-rated movie instead after deliveries got mixed up, the publisher said on Friday.

Larousse publishers, known for its dictionaries and encyclopaedias, said children in the village of Lezignan-Corbieres in southern France realised something was wrong only after starting the tape, a film entitled "El corredor del hombre" (Man's Passage).

"We'd entrusted the copying of our cassettes to an editor who mistakenly supplied us with the remainder of a stock of erotic tapes which had not yet been labelled and which was destined for a Spanish customer," said Edith Flachaire, head of marketing at Larousse.
"We are going to withdraw all the tapes from sale in the region immediately and we will replace them with models which have been checked by us," she added.
Larousse published a statement in which it pledged to replace all "faulty" tapes, and offered the Lezignan-Corbieres children a free subscription to its' Bible series.
